hero.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Landscape editorial anime illustration for the Russian manga and collectibles shop «Дворец Аниме». An evocative small Tokyo-inspired neighborhood bookshop at dusk with cream paper shelves of colorful unlettered manga spines, display cabinets containing miniature anime collectible figures in varied poses, a subtle red lantern and a cobalt-blue evening sky outside. Premium hand-drawn anime background art, fine ink outlines, warm ivory light, cinnabar red and deep indigo accents, gentle hand-painted texture, sophisticated composition, no generic neon cyberpunk. No people, no legible lettering, no logos, no prices. Cozy discovery and collecting mood. Landscape 3:2, image will be beside an HTML headline so no text inside. Fictional artistic illustration, not the actual Moscow store.
